g.text: SilkOps: skills compose ops scripts over the host CLI
skills/ — one SKILL.md each, ≤2500 bytes: verdict first, one line per step
ops/ — bash + Python 3.9 stdlib; one JSON object on stdout, text on stderr,
fixed exit codes (0 2 3 4 5 6 7 1); every script sources lib/prelude.sh
ops/lib/prelude.sh: redact, result, fail, markers, facts_paths
tokens: environment only, never argv or URLs
Never merges, never pushes a protected branch, never edits a closed issue. A human merges.
